holes.cause: language pattern filled from configuration/DB value (e.g. %sitename%)
holes.accepted: The site name (Global Configuration sitename), printed by Joomla's footer line MOD_FOOTER_LINE1 (core mod_footer module 136); Tracy sets it to the customer's business name when it provisions the site, so it is not demo content. The template_overrides row matches only because an override is named after the template.
Joomla core User - Terms and Conditions plugin label on the registration form (PLG_USER_TERMS_FIELD_LABEL, plg_user_terms.ini); the trashed menu item 123 matches only by coincidence.
The "Joomla!" link of the core footer line MOD_FOOTER_LINE2 (language/en-GB/mod_footer.ini); the admin-only Login Support module holds the same address by coincidence.

The site name (Global Configuration sitename) the T4 logo prints as its title and alt when the template's site_name setting is empty (templates/ja_nova/html/layouts/t4/element/logo.php); Tracy sets it to the customer's business name when it provisions the site, so it is not demo content. The language key T4_TPL_DESC_1 matches only by coincidence.

The language key T4_TPL_DESC_1 matches only by coincidence.
Joomla core string COM_CONTENT_MORE_ARTICLES (com_content.ini) above the category blog links; the template key TPL_MORE_ITEMS matches only by coincidence.
